description: Election Commission - Declare that M. Sembakutti elected as the Chairman of the Hikkaduwa Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the office of Chairman of the Hikkaduwa Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with an electoral process at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
